French regulator to monitor YouTubers for election bias

France's media regulator, Arcom, announced that top YouTubers will be subject to rules designed to ensure media pluralism during election campaigns. These regulations, previously applied to traditional media like news channels and radio stations, will now extend to influential content creators in the lead-up to the next presidential election. The move reflects the growing influence of YouTubers whose audiences often rival or exceed those of traditional media outlets.
